entry_points.text: Getter returns per-CPU operations pointer for index. SME DVMSync marks calling CPU in global mask.

Early validator requires 64-bit fit, descending non-overlapping fields and strictly ascending registers, warning or aborting otherwise. Index builder maps numbers to descriptors warning on range and duplicates.
KPTI swaps standard vector for hardening vector; parser converts boolean string to tristate. Hooks program E0PD, LS64, BTI, DIT and POE controls, BTI ordered.

exports.text: Errata table of workaround caps with description, id, scope, matcher, optional MIDR and enable, empty-terminated; diag reports bitmap; mutable holders force selected registers and software values; safe merge by class, unknown faults; CTR strict except I-cache weakest with top RES1 safe1 and D-min safe1.

Boot sorts then seeds cache, counter and ID views with conditional 32-bit, vector, MPAM and tag handling. Secondaries merge safe and taint once on strict divergence. No EL1 AArch32 drops checks. Encoded reads apply overrides else fault. Tag needs MTE2+. Counts AArch32 2+7+6+3+3, AArch64 CTR, DCZID, CNTFRQ plus families.

Vector common and ever-seen maps use shared min-max, bitmap by max, top-down probe collapsing to effective. Predicates share inclusive range with signedness, user and always variants. System scope uses sanitised view, local uses direct read forbidding preemptible context. Fallback intersects task and housekeeping masks.

AMU presence, any-CPU and frequency visible; counters AMU or zero by build. CNP denied in kdump or disable-cap else match. BBML3 at L3 or allow-list, wrapper delegates. MTE needs no CNP, programs MAIR, controls, seed and status, flushes, clears zero page once. Late tests check optional, permitted and panic bits.

hazards.text: Speculative address-translation and unprivileged-load lists mark Cortex, Kryo and Neoverse parts needing protection.
TRBE overwrite-fill, write out of range, TSB flush failure, broken AMU constant counter and broken AArch32 AES affect listed Cortex, Neoverse and Cobalt revisions.
Cavium ThunderX and OcteonTX2 plus Ampere AC03 and AC04 lists mark families needing errata handling.
When raw cache type hides coherence shown by effective value, control register is adjusted to trap user cache-type reads for emulation.

invariants.text: Device tree accepts spin-table and PSCI, ACPI accepts parking plus PSCI. Choice stored per CPU in init-only array and read via getter. Feature log uses fixed prefix.

MIDR lists empty-terminated and build-gated, for TLBI repeat, cache traps and SSBS. N1 1542419 needs N1 plus DIC evaluated non-preemptible. Apple PMU needs hyp, IMPDEF version and Apple MIDR. GIC SEIS adds trap bit. SME needs SME plus range. PMU enable sets bit56 preserving rest.
Capability pointer table immutable after init. Non-global flag defaults off. Per-CPU vectors default standard. Mismatch uses enable flag off, static key and 32-bit CPU mask.

Matchers bind register, shift, width and signedness with min-max or reverse intervals. ISAR, PFR, ZFR, FPFR and MMFR tables use mostly 4-bit fields with visibility, strictness and safe per field. PAuth, BTI, MTE and GCS conditional. Granules exact or lower-safe, only spec-error higher-safe. Stage-2 mismatch advises no KVM, PA and page-size tolerated.

Registry pairs id with descriptor of name, table, override and consolidated, strict and user views. Memory, debug, zero and tag fields mostly hidden strict lower-wins. PMU and profiling nonstrict, counts strict, version safe6. Shareability safe15, prohibit default1. Insert preserves bits. Sorted for binary search.

Pseudo-NMI off by default, revoked on broken quirk. Identical fields untouched, differences resolved safe. Strictness relaxable per field. First 32-bit secondary seeds baseline once. 32-bit capability tolerates absence when allowed.

KPTI from safety bit and latches unsafe; Cavium forces off, KASLR, mitigations, build and tristate decide with parser overwriting. NV1 needs nested and not-Apple. LPA2 needs both granules. PMU and RAS from sanitised fields. System match bounds-checks then dispatches.

DBM and AMU succeed at system scope admitting late CPUs; masks only gain. DBM per CPU needs local plus not-broken, sets TCR bit, orders, flushes and records. AMU records and refreshes unless broken counter. EL2 via hyp query. Nested needs nested hyp plus multi-cap.

PAN clears SPAN and PSTATE never, warns in IRQ. DISR zeroed. Address auth forbids system scope; boot checks minimum, secondaries need minimum plus equality; metas OR variants. GIC priorities need interface plus pseudo-NMI ordered, relaxed adds PMR and clear hint. DIR trap hyp-gated, frozen post-finalize under protected KVM, tests bit. Protected equals hyp query.

state_machines.text: Errata follow detect then enable. Local errata evaluate per CPU while system and weak-local features admit late CPUs differently. SME enable records CPU only when capability present.
Boot field init validates each override to applied, redundant, dropped with mask cleared, or unrepresentable cleared, then folds result into consolidated and user views.

structs.text: Entries carry description, number, scope, matcher, optional list, range or mask and enable hook. Fix masks A53 bit8, A510 bit25, C1-Pro revision bit0. QCOM covers Falkor, Kryo and Oryon CNTVOFF. Compat default combines halfword, Thumb, multiply, DSP, TLS, divide and LPA with first word preset.
Field descriptors record signedness, visibility, strictness, safety, shift, width and safe value. Signed and unsigned constructors select signedness. Zero width terminates.
